profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NASA Goddard

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Spacecraft · Computer Science · Operating Systems · System Testing · Flight Software

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Deep space GPS receiver software, firmware, testing for lunar missions and beyond.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing software solutions for clustered satellite including a platform for distributed operations, writing satellite imagery machine learning applications, and running full network array simulations.

positions.title: Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Engineering solutions for clients using web frameworks and full stack development, technology support, IT systems development, low level real-time programming, and app development. Researching space technologies using computational fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and spacecraft operating systems.

positions.title: Space and Intelligence Systems Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Administered Developer Operations pipeline for black box communication chassis project including scratch building a Selenium web automation Java testing framework and spearheading wi-fi packet analysis and Sharepoint development projects for proprietary systems division.

positions.title: Orion MPCV Flight Software Testing Intern
positions.description: Developed Orion Flight Software code coverage software, integrated code components from Honeywell, CACI, and Lockheed Martin, generated Orion test reports for flight software developers, ran simulations of Orion Flight Software.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: RECONSO Satellite Research Assistant
positions.description: Fabricated a cube satellite for tracking and reconnaissance of space objects, developed flight avionics software using NASA Core Flight Executive, connected and tested flight hardware from ground radio communications to GPS modules.

positions.title: Husky Robotics Research Assistant
positions.description: Collaborated with team of programmers to develop an interactive robotics demonstration. Utilized Stanford's Robotics Open Source (ROS) framework, wrote code that interpreted commands from human speech, publishing to other nodes for further action.

courses.name: Architecture, Concurrency, and Energy in Computation
